subregion.name: The Ancestral Vaults

subregion.name: Grand Columbarium

subregion.name: The North Ossuary
subregion.summary: High-ceilinged stone halls and stacked niches holding centuries of skeletal remains.

subregion.name: The Silent Mortuary
subregion.summary: Secluded preparation rooms and ceremonial halls secluded along the eastern boundary.

subregion.name: The Sunken Passage
subregion.summary: A narrow, damp complex of outer corridors leading inward from the far western perimeter.

subregion.name: The Weeping Chambers
subregion.summary: A labyrinth of low-vaulted tombs and moisture-slick passages across the southeastern interior.
